newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian ringgit market closed for festival.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian ringgit market closed for festival.

text.p: The Malaysian foreign exchange market is closed on Monday for a Hindu festival.
On Friday, the ringgit was rangebound as players refrained from taking new positions ahead of the long weekend.
Dealers said the ringgit traded in a very tight range despite some ringgit/Sing dollar unwinding.
The ringgit closed at 2.5193/203 a dollar on Friday against 2.5203/13 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Thursday. It was at 1.7981/97 per Singapore dollar against 1.7944/58.
